legal.termsIntro: By using the platform you agree to the terms below.
legal.t1Body: The platform provides contract management, partner management and AI assistant tools for your organisation. Features may vary by the plan your organisation subscribes to.
legal.t2Body: You are responsible for keeping your password secret and for all activity under your account. Tell your administrator immediately if you suspect misuse.
legal.t3Body: Data you enter or upload belongs to your organisation. We process it only to provide the service and do not sell it to third parties.
legal.t4Body: Results from the AI assistant are for reference only. Check them before using them for legal, financial or signing decisions.
legal.t5Body: Do not use the platform to break the law, infringe others' rights, or try to gain unauthorised access to other organisations' systems and data.
legal.t6Body: These terms may be updated; a new version takes effect when posted on this page. For questions, contact your organisation's administrator or the platform provider.
legal.privacyIntro: This policy describes how the platform collects and uses your information.
legal.p1Body: Account information (name, username, email), contract and partner data you enter or upload, conversations with the AI assistant, and access logs for security.
legal.p2Body: To provide and operate the service, protect accounts, send contract reminders and improve quality. We never use your organisation's data for another organisation.
legal.p3Body: Data is separated per organisation, sent over encrypted channels and reachable only by authorised people in your organisation. We keep it while your organisation uses the service.
legal.p4Body: We do not sell information. Content sent to AI models is used only to answer your request and as configured by your organisation.
legal.p5Body: You may ask to view, correct or delete your personal information through your organisation's administrator.
legal.p6Body: Send privacy questions to your organisation's administrator or the platform provider.
